leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures pen and marker packaging from our ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom APET crystal-clear blister packs and clamshell packaging for the complete writing instrument range. Bulk pen packaging from Vapi for pen brands, stationery companies, and school supply manufacturers across India and for export. As a pen packaging manufacturer from India, we supply APET blister packs for pens, markers, highlighters, gel pens, and premium writing instruments.

Pen and marker packaging is the most precision-demanding stationery packaging application — pen barrel diameters range from 6mm (fine point gel pens) to 12mm (thick marker barrels) and narrow cylindrical cavity geometry must be consistent to ±0.5mm to ensure proper pen seating and prevent tipping in the blister. APET crystal-clear is the standard material — the consumer must see the pen colour, the tip type, and the barrel design through the packaging.

sections.st: Three Problems Pen & Marker Packaging Buyers Face

strips.title: Product Colour Not Visible — Pen Colour is the Primary Purchase Signal
strips.desc: Problem: Pen packaging in low-clarity materials hides the pen colour — the single most important purchase signal for gel pens, markers, and colour writing instruments. Consumer cannot see what they are selecting. Solution: APET crystal-clear thermoforming — full pen colour visibility, accurate colour representation through the packaging.

strips.title: Pen Tipping in Cavity — Incorrect Narrow Cavity Diameter
strips.desc: Problem: Narrow-cavity blister packs where cavity diameter is slightly too large allow pen barrels to tip — the pen is visible at a 15-degree angle rather than upright, creating a poor retail shelf presentation. Solution: Precision CNC-tooled narrow-cavity geometry confirmed per production batch — pen barrel sits upright in cavity with no tipping.

strips.title: Multi-Pen Pack Organisation — Each Pen in Correct Colour Sequence
strips.desc: Problem: Multi-pen packs (10-colour gel pen sets, 5-colour marker sets) where pens are not in the correct colour sequence create poor colour display presentation at retail. Solution: Multi-cavity APET blister designed with each pen position corresponding to the brand's intended colour sequence.

sections.st: Pen & Marker Packaging — Key Design Requirements

strips.title: Crystal-Clear APET — Pen Colour Display Standard
strips.desc: APET crystal-clear thermoforming for all pen and marker packaging — full pen colour and tip design visible through the packaging. APET standard for all retail pen blister packs. PETG for luxury writing instrument gift packaging requiring superior optical clarity.

strips.title: Precision Narrow Cavity — Pen Barrel Diameter Confirmed
strips.desc: Pen barrel diameter confirmed from physical pen sample before cavity tooling. CNC-tooled cavity at precise diameter — pen sits upright with no tipping, no excessive clearance. Dimensional inspection per production batch.

strips.title: Tamper-Evident Heat Seal Flange — Retail Security Standard
strips.desc: APET blister heat-sealed to paperboard card with tamper-evident flange. Heat seal flange width and profile confirmed from the brand's card sealing equipment specification.

strips.title: Colour Sequence Layout — Multi-Pen Set Display
strips.desc: Multi-pen set blister designed with pen cavity positions matching the brand's intended colour sequence display. Rainbow sequence, brand-specific arrangement, or colour family grouping confirmed from brand specification before tooling.

faqs.q: What pen and marker packaging does Trizen manufacture?
faqs.a: Custom APET crystal-clear blister packs and clamshell packaging for ball pens, gel pens, markers, highlighters, fine-point technical pens, luxury writing instruments, and pen refill packs. ISO 9001:2015. Bulk pen packaging from Vapi, Gujarat.

faqs.q: What is precision narrow cavity for pen packaging?
faqs.a: Pen barrel diameters range from 6mm to 12mm. Thermoformed narrow cavity at precise diameter — 0.5mm error causes tipping or improper seating. CNC-tooled with dimensional inspection per batch.

faqs.q: APET vs PETG for pen and marker packaging?
faqs.a: APET crystal-clear for all standard pen blister packs — sufficient clarity for retail pen colour display at OEM cost efficiency. PETG for luxury writing instruments and premium pen gift sets requiring superior optical clarity.
